facade materials, windows, parapets and pitched roofs are generic estimates
road polygons do not establish permissions or markings
no bridges are modelled in the extension; Deep West trees (west-campus-v1.json) are 2017 LiDAR peaks
West Campus tower plans, podiums, crowns and all deep-west facade treatments are estimates
